title: Sosulski et al. 2019 — Online Optimization of Stimulation Speed in an Auditory Brain-Computer Interface under Time Constraints
description: EEG recordings from 13 healthy participants performing an auditory oddball (P300) task with target (1000 Hz) and non-target (500 Hz) tones at varying stimulus onset asynchronies (60-600 ms). The dataset supports research on closed-loop Bayesian optimization of stimulation speed in an auditory brain-computer interface. Data were recorded with 31 EEG channels at 1000 Hz, in an optimization part and a validation part.
methods_description: 31-channel EEG (BrainProducts BrainAmp DC, passive Ag/AgCl, nose reference, 1000 Hz) was recorded during an auditory oddball paradigm. Each trial had 15 target and 75 non-target tones. The optimization part ran four SOA-selection strategies (AUC-ucb, AUC-rand, P300-ucb, P300-rand) for 20 minutes each. The validation part tested the selected SOAs plus a fixed 60 ms SOA with 20 trials each. Classification used shrinkage-regularized LDA on mean amplitudes in five time intervals, with 13-fold cross-validation.
